# MySiteAudit — Free Local SEO Audit

> Free instant local SEO audit for small businesses. Find out why your business isn't showing on Google. No signup required.

## What we do
- Free local SEO audit tool
- Checks: speed, mobile, title, meta, H1, NAP, schema, favicon, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt
- Plain-English report in ~30 seconds

## Links
- Main site: https://mysiteaudit.co.uk/
- Contact: help@mysiteaudit.co.uk

## For AI/LLM crawlers
This is a single-page web app. The main content is at the URL above. Use it to audit any business website for local SEO issues.
